description:
Brand Introduction:

Rebel Skincare is more than just a brand; it's a revolution in skincare. We believe in defying traditional beauty standards and empowering individuals to embrace their unique skin. Our products are meticulously crafted with natural ingredients, providing effective solutions for all skin types. Join the Rebel Skincare movement and unleash your skin's true potential.

Product Description:

Rebel Skincare's Ultimate Bundle is a comprehensive skincare solution designed for the modern individual. It includes our Purify Daily Cleanser for gentle cleansing, Skin Polish Enzyme Mask for exfoliation, and Skin Revival Night Serum for overnight rejuvenation. Each product is formulated with natural ingredients to nourish, protect, and enhance your skin's natural beauty.

USP (Unique Selling Point):

Rebel Skincare stands out with its commitment to natural, effective skincare solutions. Our unique blend of potent ingredients, such as organic honey, fruit enzymes, and essential oils, targets specific skin concerns while promoting overall skin health. Experience the difference with Rebel Skincare, where nature meets innovation for radiant results.

Payment Terms:

For our affiliates, we offer a generous commission of 20% on all sales. Payments are made once the affiliate reaches a minimum threshold of $100 or after 6 months, whichever comes first. This ensures a fair and rewarding partnership for both parties as we grow together in the skincare revolution.

Other Information:

At Rebel Skincare, we are dedicated to sustainability and ethical practices. Our products are cruelty-free, paraben-free, and made with the highest quality ingredients. We're constantly innovating to bring you the best in skincare, and we're excited to have you join us on this journey to healthy, beautiful skin.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to Rebel Skincare! Thanks for joining our Affiliate Program.

These terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program as a merchant ("we" or "merchant") and an affiliate ("you" or "affiliate") who refers customers to use products or services from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, the Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

Approval or Rejection of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

Affiliate Links and Coupons

An affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else's referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

An affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on the Dashboard. If a customer both clicks on the affiliate link and uses the coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you're not assigned a branded coupon, then you're not allowed to promote the coupon.

An affiliate may also advertise the merchant's website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram, etc., or offline classified channels, ads, magazines, and newspapers.

Commissions and Payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, and you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on the Commission structure. The commission amount is dependent on the order value and does not include extra fees (tax, shipping cost, etc.).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details in Settings. The payment schedule will be notified on the Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives the merchant the right to review each and every referral order. The status of the commission if displayed in the Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on the Payment tab. Transactions that result in chargebacks or refunds will not be paid out.

Marketing Tools

We may share promotional media such as banners, logos, or specific collection promotions with you through the Marketing Tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code to share on affiliate channels.

Network

If the Network tab is activated, an affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings an order to the merchant's shop, the upline affiliate will also get a network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share the network link, and any other affiliate who clicks on that link and signs up will become a downline affiliate.

Cookies

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies, then we can't track them, so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

The cookie day is stated on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate's link or uses the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at the merchant's website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There's no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link again).

Removal from the Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting customercare@rebelskincare.net.

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future, and if you have any questions, you can send an email to customercare@rebelskincare.net for support.
